> SwanDigitals is an innovative Indian enterprise dedicated to the development and deployment of personalized AI chatbots and voice agents. The company specializes in automating customer support, KYC verification, and IT helpdesk services, with a commitment to rapid deployment—typically within one week. SwanDigitals emphasizes data sovereignty and compliance with regulations such as DPDP 2023, offering a comprehensive omnichannel platform that supports over ten Indian languages. Their unique selling proposition includes zero data collection, allowing clients to maintain full control over their data, and the provision of advanced AI agents capable of managing complex tasks. Targeting Indian enterprises, SwanDigitals is positioned within the dynamic AI and digital transformation market, focusing on security and operational flexibility.
